name: a2ui-renderer
title_zh: 把 Agent 的界面声明渲染成可交互 UI
tagline_zh: CopilotKit v2 里，Agent 说一句界面声明，你这边自动渲染成组件。不用手写 renderActiv。
tagline_en: In CopilotKit v2, let your agent declare UI and get it rendered automatically. No manual renderActivityMessages.
desc_en: Render A2UI (Agent-to-UI declarative surfaces) in CopilotKit v2. Enable the runtime via CopilotRuntime({ a2ui: {...} }), then enable the provider via <CopilotKit a2ui={{ theme }}>. Auto-activates via /info — do NOT manually pass renderActivityMessages. createA2UIMessageRenderer ships from @copilotkit/react-core/v2; low-level primitives (A2UIProvider, A2UIRenderer, createCatalog) ship from @copilot
why_zh: 声明式渲染，运行时自动激活。底层原语齐全，主题可配，省掉胶水代码。
why_en: Declarative rendering with auto-activation at runtime. Full low-level primitives, themeable, zero glue code.
limit_zh: 只认 CopilotKit v2 的 A2UI 协议；v1 不兼容。必须自行启用 runtime 和 provider。
limit_en: Only works with CopilotKit v2's A2UI protocol; v1 incompatible. Requires manual a2ui config on both runtime and provider, or /info won't trigger.
